edits.find: CLSI H20-A2 defines the reference method as two reviewers counting 200 cells each. 200 is one observer's share of it, which is what routine single-observer practice does — a documented default, not a claim to perform the reference method.
edits.replace: ICSH 2008 §2.6: at least 500 cells when a precise percentage of an abnormal cell type is required for diagnosis; at least 300 when the differential is not essential to it.
